result.summary: Found 1 major visual break (missing Orders icon in bottom navigation) and 2 minor layout clipping issues at the carousel edge and bottom card.

issues.description: Bottom navigation 'Orders' tab shows label but no visible icon, while Home, Search and Profile all show icons above labels
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon asset and ensure it renders in inactive grey state like Search and Profile

issues.description: Last restaurant card in 'Popular right now' (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off flush against the top edge of the bottom tab bar with no spacing and no name/metadata visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area margin so the card is fully visible or clearly scrollable above the tab bar

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped mid-element on the right edge, showing truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' and clipped '20-30 min' badge
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the horizontal carousel so cards snap with full visibility and text is not cut mid-word
